description: OpenAI-compatible chat completion API: call 400+ LLMs (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Llama, Mistral) per request, pay with x402, no API key. Pay only for what you use: sign a ceiling based on your max_tokens, settle for real usage x 1.10 (min $0.001) once the call completes. Try GET /v1/chat/completions/sample.

max_tokens.description: Max completion tokens, capped at 4096 - also bounds the x402 upto price ceiling.

model.description: OpenRouter model id from GET /v1/models, e.g. "openai/gpt-4o-mini".
